start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aap plants ke naam batayiye.

turns.line: wo ped ke liye apni jaan de dete hain na?
turns.reply: Aapne yaad dilaya ki kuch jaanwar pedon ke liye apni jaan de dete hain; ant mein is baat par lautenge. School garden mein pehle kaunsa plant chunenge?
